info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to pray, to worship, to glorify, to praise

info.name: hindI arTa
info.value: prArTanA karanA, stuti karanA, praSaMsA karanA, Bajana karanA

examples: 'pra samrAjaM carzaRInAmindraM stotA navyaM gIrBiH' (f॰8.16.1). praSabdaH prakarze.
